lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: I heard, Chiron, that although you were a god, you took a fancy to dying.

lines.speaker: Chiron
lines.text: You heard correctly, Menippus. And here I am dead, as you can see, though I could have been immortal.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: What possessed you to fall in love with death? Most people find it hard to court.

lines.speaker: Chiron
lines.text: I’ll tell you, since you are not without sense. Immortality was no longer pleasant to enjoy.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: It wasn’t pleasant to be alive and see the light?

lines.speaker: Chiron
lines.text: No, Menippus. Pleasure, in my view, is a mixed thing, not a simple one. I was alive forever, enjoying the same things—sun, light, food; the same seasons, the same events, each following the next in order, one thing trailing another. I became thoroughly full of them. Pleasure is not only in having the same thing always, but also in sometimes not having it at all.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Well put, Chiron. And how are you taking things in Hades, now that you chose them and came here?

lines.speaker: Chiron
lines.text: Not unpleasantly, Menippus. The equality here is extremely democratic, and it makes no real difference whether one is in the light or in the dark. Besides, there is no need to be thirsty up here, as there was above, nor hungry. We are free of all those requirements.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Careful, Chiron. You may be walking into yourself, and your argument may end up in the same place.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: If the constant sameness of life became cloying to you, then the sameness here may become cloying in exactly the same way. Then you’ll have to look for some change from here into another life—which, I think, is going to be difficult.

lines.speaker: Chiron
lines.text: Then what is a person to do, Menippus?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: What they say a sensible person does, I suppose: be satisfied, make the best of what is present, and not imagine any of it is unbearable.
